one_line: Nvidia investigates its CEO over an affair, Anthropic secures massive gas generation, and AI stock issuance tops $300 billion.

themes.title: Nvidia investigates CEO over alleged spy ties
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a Megaspeed executive alleged by U.S. officials to be a Chinese spy. The board stated it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.

stories.headline: Nvidia board launches investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admits affair
Nvidia board launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy plot
Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy

themes.title: Anthropic buys power generation and stock sales surge
themes.text: Anthropic purchased 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from OnePWR for $3.4 billion to meet surging energy demand. Meanwhile, AI companies sold or priced over $300 billion of stock in 2026 following a tech sell-off that erased $2.5 trillion in Nasdaq market value.

stories.headline: Anthropic buys 1.7GW of gas-fired generators in $3.4B deal
AI companies sell $300B+ in stock in 2026 amid market absorption questions

themes.title: Agent apps grow and hardware expands
themes.text: DeepSeek reported that its open-source agent application Harness reached 1.54 million daily active users. Google announced new TPU systems for secure inference and long-context tasks, and Apple CEO John Ternus pushed for an accelerated AI strategy focused on autonomous agents.

stories.headline: DeepSeek says Harness agent app reached 1.54M daily active users
Google expands TPU family with TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems
Apple CEO John Ternus pushes for accelerated AI strategy and agentic Siri
